text:
marco: opened PR to tidy SDK snippets for streaming + pagination (py/ts/go). aim: canonical cursor="" start, show per-call deadlines and client-side stop patterns, add tiny knob cheat. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/521. can ppl quick review?
emma: quick read. TS should show AbortController stop-after-N and note abort semantics (server may still send final partial event).
oliver: agree on normalizing cursor to \"\". for python prefer `async for` + `asyncio.wait_for` to bound the whole call.
emma: added TS example: ```ts
const ac = new AbortController();
const stream = client.responses.stream({model: 'redwood-mini', input: q, signal: ac.signal});
let i = 0;
for await (const pkt of stream) { process(pkt); if (++i >= 30) ac.abort(); }
```
marco: for Go please show context.WithTimeout and include resume token header example. snippet: ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 200*time.Millisecond)
defer cancel()
req.Headers.Set("x-resume-token", token)
stream, _ := client.StreamResponses(ctx, req)
for stream.Next() { ev := stream.Event(); handle(ev) }
```
oliver: python snippet: ```py
async def fetch(q):
  async for c in client.responses.stream(model='redwood-mini', input=q):
    handle(c)
await asyncio.wait_for(fetch(q), timeout=0.2)
```
emma: small doc nit: older snippets used `null` and \"\" inconsistently. good to unify and add one sentence: "Use \"\" to request first page; server will return a cursor token when there is more to read."
marco: added a compact knob cheat under examples: "batching -> higher throughput; per-call deadline -> bounded latency; TTL cache -> fewer cold starts." also included a 2-line migration note for v1->v2 snippet users.
docs-bot: PR 521 updated: snippet smoke-tests passed and docs linter green.
oliver: LGTM
emma: lgtm
marco: merging in 10m unless any objections. will monitor release bot and follow up on feedback.
